primary_failure_definition: Issue remains unresolved at the 180-day deadline from creation, or is resolved after that deadline.
population_rule: Use only rows with a real cutoff-safe story-point estimate and an eligible primary outcome label.
reason_for_primary_outcome: This provides 3,045 effort-qualified eligible rows. A three-outcome any-adverse label would leave only 1,172 rows and would require an unvalidated probability-combination assumption.
evaluation_note: This is a retrospective replay of selection quality, not evidence that the optimizer caused future outcomes.
